Thanks Elena — appreciate the quick response and the VAT certificate. A few follow-ups from tax/compliance:

- Please also provide a Certificate of Fiscal Residence if available (Italian Agenzia delle Entrate confirmation or equivalent). This speeds up withholding/reverse-charge checks.
- For Redwood to apply reverse-charge we need to confirm both: (1) Redwood Italy s.r.l. will be the billed entity (we will confirm the VAT ID) and (2) an explicit statement on the invoice that reverse charge applies (Art. 194 of Directive 2006/112/EC).
- If you issue invoices with VAT, finance needs to know whether CloudSync will accept eventual VAT reclamation or credit notes in case of tax jurisdiction adjustments.

Monica — once Elena uploads the completed onboarding form and the residence cert, can you open the PO request in Coupa (or attach to PO-2026-4532 Excel) and flag it for EU-billing? I will confirm final tax routing with tax counsel if needed.
